title: How to Get One of the BEST Defense Capes in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 - Obsidian Cape Guide
author: GamerCory
description:
How to Get the Obsidian Cape — One of the BEST Defense Capes! | RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0

The Obsidian Cape gives you extra melee, ranged, and magic defense. To unlock it, you’ll need to complete the Brink of Extinction quest in Umbral Sands.

In this guide, I’ll show you where to find Zi, what items to bring, all four fire pedestal locations, the Cave of Screams bouncer’s answer, and how to finish the quest and craft your Obsidian Cape.

Bring 3 Raw Beltfish and 1 Cactus Steak to get started. After completing the quest, use the Plate of Pure Obsidian vestige to unlock the cape recipe at your Armour Bench.

More RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides as I progress through the game — subscribe if you want quick guides without wasting your time.
